home.metaTitle: AppTray Labs | Privacy-first digital utility ecosystem
home.metaDescription: Explore six fast, offline-ready AppTray Labs apps for exams, EMI and GST, network diagnostics, jap counting, focused music and secure document transfer.
home.ecosystemTitle: Six focused apps, one trusted portal
home.ecosystemDescription: Each subdomain has its own performance budget and offline cache. Launch directly on the parent domain that is currently serving this site.
home.previewsKicker: Try it here, then go deeper
home.previewsDescription: Every widget below runs in your browser. Results stay on this device unless you choose to open the full application.
home.closingTitle: Start with one tool. Stay for the ecosystem.
home.closingDescription: No account is required to try a preview. Open the full app when you need saved history, deeper settings or offline installation.

trust.title: Privacy first
trust.text: Local state by default, clear ad disclosures.

calculator.description: Live EMI and GST preview using decimal.js with half-up rounding. Inputs persist offline.

speed.description: Six real HTTP round trips to the current origin. Jitter is the mean change between consecutive samples.

exam.description: National and state practice questions with instant explanations. Your score saves locally.

jap.description: Tap through a 108-bead cycle with tactile feedback and a sample Vedic calendar strip.

music.description: A soft generated tone stands in for audio here. The full app adds crossfade, EQ, lyrics and offline playback.

cafe.description: Tick what you have ready before visiting a trustworthy cyber café. Your checklist persists on this device.

chrome.consent: We use essential local storage to remember your preferences. With your permission, Google AdSense may use cookies to show relevant ads.
chrome.install: Install AppTray Labs for offline-ready, one-tap access.
chrome.errorText: The portal hit an unexpected error. Your saved widget data is intact. Reload to continue.
